title: Late-Billing Reduction Rate Card for Ostomy Supply Program Expedite Charges
content:
**Billing office rate card - Ostomy Supply Program.** A late-billing reduction applies to the charge for a refill shipped expedited at the customer's request, according to the calendar days from the refill's ship date to today.

| Days from ship date to today | Late-billing rate |
|---|---|
| More than 90 | 10% (the larger late-billing rate) |
| More than 60 and at most 90 | 5% (the smaller late-billing rate) |
| 60 or fewer | None |

The late-billing rate is taken off the fee.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** 60 days: none. 61 days: 5%. 90 days: 5%. 91 days: 10%.
